## Triage: first grade — `tooling` · `priority:p1` · `domain:skills` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-27T01:53Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **p1:** the maintainer asked for this directly (「任务很多，还能加速吗」, 「同时立一张skills卡优化技能」, 2026-10-27), and the measured hold (3 of 13 spec cards dispatchable) slows the 18.2 work itself. That is release throughput, so 「发版本优先的都p1」 applies.
- **What already has the maintainer's word:** items 1 and 2 (the seat settles scope against an accepted ADR or ruling, and the seat moves `domain:*` when the remainder is measured to be all its own package) rest on 「这种问题为什么要问分诊，你可以自己判断」. The PR may write them in, with that quote as `Ruling-ref`. Until it lands, triage answers such asks within the round. #26000 and #25653 were answered at 2026-10-27T01:00Z (R694).
- **What does not:** item 3 (area-axis serial → file-surface serial) and item 4 (a standing model/effort posture per project) change rules that guard against merge collisions and spend. Each goes to the maintainer as a decision with options and workload before it is written. ⛔ Not folded into the same PR without that word.
- **Lane:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` is `domain:skills`, Tier S. Mind the `check:pm-skill-ratchet` headroom: every touched file is at its ceiling.

## Dispatch order · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-27T03:54Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26387, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26387" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`), and the audit it comes from (#26184 comment 6425678185, Part A, § pm-dispatch); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26387` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26387 --file=F` (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Maintainer's words in the `domain:spec` seat 1 project thread, 2026-10-27, verbatim as the card quotes them: 「任务很多，还能加速吗」 (01:39Z), 「你两个座位可以处理10张卡啊，问题不在座位」 (01:41Z), 「这种问题为什么要问分诊，你可以自己判断。#26000：带 `pm:retriage`。它和已裁的 ADR-0141 D8 冲突，在等分诊答复。」 (01:42Z), 「同时立一张skills卡优化技能」 (01:42Z). Triage first grade: comment 6431784222 (01:53Z) — **p1**, `tooling`, `domain:skills`, `area:devpath`, Tier S (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`). Triage's split is binding: the card's items **1 and 2** have the maintainer's word and are this PR's whole scope; items **3 and 4** (area-axis serial → file-surface serial; a standing model/effort posture per project) do NOT — the seat has put them to the maintainer as a decision card; ⛔ do not write them into this PR under any wording. The maintainer's standing word on skills-lane threads (「卡线程用天花板档,并行跑」, 2026-10-27 00:33Z) sets your tier.

### Scope and tier

File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` only — the rule lines that today send a self-decidable call to triage, measured on `origin/main` (seat, 03:55Z): `SKILL.md` L34 (「执行席只在本车道认领,永不改 `domain:*`」), L112 (the `pm:retriage` row: 「向分诊提问(改判、跨域 PR 指定车道、改路由、拆卡、裁 dev 报告留下的分叉)」); `references/execution-duties.md` L60 (「余项需换道/拆分加 `pm:retriage`,自队列重新认领」); `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L154 (「砍范围、降级、关卡是卡的命运,归人工地板 ⛔ 不借改卡裁;读数落认领 `Premise:` 行」); `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L32 (「误标 ⛔ 不自行改,挂 `pm:retriage` + 异议评论同笔」) and L40 (「`pm:retriage` 改路由只对未派发卡」); `references/triage-duties.md` L77 if the triage side of the loop must change. Touch no other file: ⛔ not `AGENTS.md` (1112/1112 lines, PD14 is the maintainer's), ⛔ not `.claude/agents/**`. Tier S: `.claude/**` only ⇒ after the ceiling-tier contract review PASS and the seat's ACCEPT the seat readies and arms it (the maintainer's standing word of 2026-10-26, 「你按照 pm-dispatch 技能审核的pr都可以落地」); you yourself never ready, arm or enqueue.

**Line ratchet** (`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` = `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`): every file you touch is AT its ceiling — `SKILL.md` 319/319, `dispatch-runbook.md` 245/245, `execution-duties.md`, `cross-repo-coordination.md`, `triage-duties.md` likewise (read the CEILINGS table). Net zero lines per file: every rule you add replaces or rewords a line in the same file; no raise is ruled (ruling A covers `skills/**` token rows, not this ratchet). Non-fence lines ≤120 bytes where the file's own gate says so (`--self-test` tells you). AGENTS.md PD14: a rule added retires one — name each retirement in the body.

### What to write (items 1 and 2, in the skill's own voice — one line each where one line fits)

1. **Seat-settled scope against governing text.** When a card's option conflicts with an accepted ADR or an existing maintainer ruling (`Ruled:` line, decision-card tap, a quoted ruling on the card), the execution seat drops the conflicting part and dispatches the rest, writing on the card which part was dropped and the governing text it cites (`Ruling-ref:` line-initial, the quote verbatim) — instead of `pm:retriage`. Narrow `dispatch-runbook.md` L154 accordingly: 砍范围 by a ruling the card itself conflicts with is the seat's reading, not the maintainer's floor; 降级 and 关卡 stay with the floor. The `pm:retriage` row (SKILL.md L112) keeps the asks that remain triage's (改判, 拆卡, 裁 dev 报告的分叉) and drops the two the seat now settles. Example to carry in the body, not the skill: #26000 vs ADR-0141 D8.
2. **Lane move for an unambiguous remainder.** When a card's remaining work is entirely inside one lane's package tree by the measured file list (every path under that lane's `domain:*` surface as the lane charters define it), the seat that owns that package may relabel `domain:*` itself, with an audit comment that lists the measured paths and the old/new label in one write — instead of the triage round-trip. Narrow SKILL.md L34 (「永不改 `domain:*`」 → the one measured exception), `execution-duties.md` L60 and `cross-repo-coordination.md` L32/L40 to match; the exception never applies to a card with a `needs-user-decision` or an open `Blocked-by:`, never to a dispatched card (L40 stays: 改路由只对未派发卡), and never to `security`-labelled cards (those keep the floor). Example in the body: #25653 (remainder all `packages/spec`, card `domain:server`).
Both items: write them so a triage seat reading the same text knows it no longer answers these two asks (the triage side L77 may need one clause); keep the red lines they sit next to intact.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act)

1. The five lines above are the only places the rule text sends these two calls to triage — grep `pm:retriage` and `domain:\*` across `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` before editing and list every hit in the report; a hit the card did not foresee is in scope only if it says the same rule.
2. No parser or gate keys on the exact wording of these lines (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `fleet-roster.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs` read labels and comment keys, not prose) — confirm by grep; `Ruling-ref:` is already a key triage uses (6431784222), so adopt that spelling.
3. `Metadata-protocol: none` ⇒ no `Skills-docs:` line owed.

### Card-specific clauses

- Done when (the card's own line): the skill text carries items 1 and 2 under the ratchet; the body records the spec lane's current 「dispatchable / open `pm:queue`」 reading before and after (read the spec lane's `pm:queue` cards over REST and count which would now be dispatchable under the new text — a reading, not a promise).
- PR body: `Fixes #26387` first (after the harness attribution), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, six-line `## 维护者速读` (Tier S: 需要你做的 = 无,席位落地), What changes with each retired line quoted before/after, the ratchet readings per file (lines before/after = equal), Tests, Verification.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your final tree, run each locally, reconcile with `--ran`; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` are the ones that read this surface. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- Serial: no open PR touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (scan at 03:55Z); PR #26381 landed the Skills-docs line in `b33dd25b` — base on `origin/main` ≥ `75afeffd`.
- ⛔ GitHub MCP tools: none, reads included (REST via curl with the bearer token from the environment, never printed; writes only through the relay). ⛔ Never write the card's labels or assignee. ⛔ No model name anywhere in the commit or PR; model-free trailer pair as `os-dev.md` spells it.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26387 whose first line is `os-dev-report`), with `deviations`, `line_budget` and `out_of_scope_findings`. Hand back one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 naming the PR number, head sha, report comment id and the premise verdict; stay subscribed for the review verdict.
